name: smwmusic-soulful-pines-of-verdane
title: Soulful Pines of Verdane
description:
A peaceful and serene tune fit for losing oneself in the whispering branches. Inspired by the story of and uses samples from Fire Emblem: Genealogy of the Holy War. Can be used for dark/forest/cave levels or similarly themed overworlds.

This was originally submitted to Battle of the Bits' contest "Oops! All New Formats", where it won a bronze medal for the MML format and 26th/260 overall.

07/11/2025 UPDATE: Improved Glockenspiel echo and upped echo to the originally intended amounts, as well as decreased the tempo a tad.
